fusions.name: Basalt Javelin
fusions.desc: A thrown basalt point that deals 9 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Charging Point
fusions.desc: Rushes you to the target first, then drives a stone point home for 16 damage.

fusions.name: Sighted Along
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Set Against the Charge
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. Your armour also rises by 6%.
